test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.

options.text: Patience is a nesecessary quality for a teacher.
The soil is necessary for plantation.
Water is a necesary element for life.
Sharp observation is naicessary for a detective.

solution:
The correct answer is, '**The soil is necessary for plantation**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is no spelling error in this sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patience is a nesecessary quality for a teacher.** Spelling error - Nesecessary.
 
• **Water is a necesary element for life**. Spelling error - Necesary. 
 
• **Sharp observation is naicessary for a detective**. Spelling error - Naicessary.
